integrity: The finding has an explicit all-parameter proof and reproducible finite checker; independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact diameter is proved for named palettes k >= n+1, with weak hypergraph properness, and is the eventual stable diameter. The least stability threshold and small-palette diameters are not determined. Earlier equivalent token-capacity terminology is a historical-priority risk. Computer tests are finite, not substitutes for the proof.
title: Sharp stable recolouring diameter of complete uniform hypergraphs
